title: Système
description: Live overview of this computer: CPU usage (total and per thread), memory usage and CPU temperature (with warning/critical thresholds); operating system (name, version, kernel/build, architecture, install date, boot time, uptime, how the previous session ended: clean or unexpected shutdown, process count); machine (name, user, manufacturer, model, domain or workgroup, physical or virtual machine); CPU model, cores, threads, frequencies and caches; memory, cache, committed memory and swap/page file; the 15 most active processes; date, time zone and NTP synchronization; system language, regional formats and keyboard; temperature sensors when the OS exposes them. Findings flag high memory or swap use, a hot CPU, an unexpected shutdown and an unsynchronized clock.

functions.name: get_processes
functions.title: Liste des processus
functions.help: Liste les processus en cours, triés par processeur, mémoire, lectures/écritures disque ou nom, avec leur chemin et leur ligne de commande (secrets masqués). Le filtre garde ceux dont le nom contient le texte.
functions.description: Running processes of this computer, sorted and filtered: name, PID, parent PID, CPU %, memory (MiB), disk read/written since start (MiB), user, start time, executable path, signature (Windows) and command line (obvious secrets such as --password=… are masked). Use it to find what slows the computer down or to check a process; the overview get_system only lists the 15 most active.

parameters.name: sortBy
parameters.label: Tri
parameters.description: Sort order: cpu (most active first), memory (largest first), io (most disk read + written since start) or name.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.label: Filtre (nom)
parameters.description: Keep only processes whose name contains this text (case-insensitive).

functions.name: get_process_tree
functions.title: Arbre des processus
functions.help: Montre quels processus en ont lancé d'autres (arbre parent → enfants), pour toute la machine ou à partir d'un PID. Utile pour savoir d'où vient un processus.
functions.description: Process tree of this computer (parent → children, indented names): PID, parent PID, number of children, CPU % and memory (MiB). Whole tree from the root processes, or the subtree of one process. Use it to see what launched a process or what a process launched.

parameters.name: processId
parameters.label: PID racine
parameters.description: PID of the process whose subtree is returned; omit for the whole tree.

functions.name: stop_process
functions.title: Arrêter un processus
functions.help: Arrête un processus par son PID (visible dans la liste des processus). « Forcer » le tue sans lui laisser le temps d'enregistrer. Les processus essentiels du système sont refusés.
functions.description: Stops one process of this computer by PID. Without force, asks it to close (Windows: closes its main window, else terminates it; Linux: SIGTERM) and waits 5 s; with force, kills it at once (unsaved data is lost). The preview shows the process (owner, path, command line, services or systemd unit it hosts, child processes). Refused for essential system or session processes, kernel threads, SysInfo itself, and other accounts' processes without administrator rights. Find the PID with system_get_processes.

parameters.name: force
parameters.label: Forcer
parameters.description: Kill at once instead of asking the program to close.

functions.name: set_priority
functions.title: Priorité d'un processus
functions.help: Change la priorité d'un processus (plus basse pour qu'il gêne moins, plus haute pour qu'il soit servi d'abord). Le réglage est perdu quand le processus redémarre.
functions.description: Changes the CPU priority of one process until it exits (Windows priority class; Linux nice value: idle 19, below_normal 10, normal 0, above_normal -5, high -10). Real-time is never offered. On Linux, raising a priority (lower nice) needs root. The preview shows the current and new priority.
